init.title: Resolve legacy volume sensors
init.description: Choose which existing entity to keep for each ambiguous volume sensor. Other legacy entities remain in the registry unchanged.

error.invalid_selection: Choose one of the listed existing entities.

volume_migration_conflict.title: Volume sensor migration conflict on {nas_name}
volume_migration_conflict.description:
Some existing volume sensors match more than one legacy entity: {conflicts}. No entities were changed or removed.

To resolve this, open **Settings > Devices & services > Integrations**, select this ASUSTOR NAS, and open its options using **Configure**. For each listed sensor, choose the existing entity used by your dashboard. The integration reloads after you save your choices.
